OkaSecure
Connection Setup
Self-hosted WebSocket. Run the server script on any PC/Pi on your network or a VPS. No third parties.
SERVER SCRIPT (run once on host machine)
# Install: npm install ws
# Run: node okatan_server.js
const WebSocket=require('ws');
const wss=new WebSocket.Server({port:8765});
const clients=new Set();
wss.on('connection',ws=>{
  clients.add(ws);
  ws.on('message',msg=>{
    clients.forEach(c=>{
      if(c!==ws&&c.readyState===1)c.send(msg);
    });
  });
  ws.on('close',()=>clients.delete(ws));
});
console.log('OKATAN Secure Line: port 8765');

TIPS
WAKE WORD — say "Hey Karen" or just "Karen" and she'll listen for your next sentence. Works while KAREN is on screen.
HANDS-FREE — non-stop conversation. Pause to send, speak over her to interrupt.
Quick tries: "Open the arcade." / "Remember my truck is a 2019 Tacoma." / "What do I drive?"
KAREN VISION
Camera + AI vision. Open the camera, then ask "what am I looking at?" — or toggle Live Mode to keep the camera on for back-to-back questions about what you see.
VISION PROVIDER
LAST SCAN
No scan yet. Tap START CAMERA, then WHAT AM I LOOKING AT?
LIVE MODE — HOW IT WORKS
When ON, the camera stays open and your voice questions are answered against the current frame instead of going to the regular text-only assistant. Toggle HANDS-FREE or WAKE WORD after enabling Live Mode for a true "JARVIS, what's that?" experience.
SMART HOME
Control your home from KAREN. Philips Hue for lights below. Webhooks for everything else — IFTTT, Home Assistant, SmartThings, Tuya, smart plugs, custom Pi setups — anything that accepts HTTP requests. Group multiple webhooks into Scenes for one-tap routines like "Movie Mode."

AGENTIC TOOLS
When you talk to OKATAN with a real AI provider selected, she can call these tools on your behalf. Destructive actions ask before running.
OKALOCAL (WEBLLM) — OFFLINE AI
Loads a real LLM that runs entirely on this device — no API key, no cloud, no cost per message. First load downloads ~1.8 GB (cached forever after). Requires WebGPU: Chrome/Edge on desktop or Safari iOS 16.4+. Llama 3.2 3B — solid for chat, weaker than cloud models for complex tasks. Note: vision queries auto-fall-back to a cloud key if available.
Not loaded.
NOTIFICATIONS
Background reminders: morning briefing, calendar 30-min warnings, habit nudges. Requires browser permission. Works best when OKATAN is installed as a PWA (Add to Home Screen).
Not enabled.

BACKUP & RESTORE
Save everything OKATAN remembers to a single file you can keep somewhere safe (Google Drive, email, etc.). Import it later to restore. Tied to this browser only; if you switch phones or clear browser data, this is your only recovery path.
